title: Sign Language Number Learning App
subtitle: Real-time number recognition and arithmetic practice with hand gestures.

home.p1: Use this app to recognize Sri Lankan Sign Language numbers from 0 to 50 in real-time.
home.p2: Then practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division using sign-based answers.
